text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Huff, puff, huff!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
(I... I did it! I was able to run in the Oka
Sho with
everything I got!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Yes!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Male Dober Fan
text_block_list.text:
That was incredible, Mejiro Dober! Do
your best
at the Japanese Oaks too!

text_block_list.name: Female Dober Fan
text_block_list.text:
Dober! You were so cool! I'll come see
you at the
Japanese Oaks for sure!

text_block_list.name: Female Spectator
text_block_list.text:
Watching you run has made me a total
fan! I'll
definitely watch your next race!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
The venue is filled with cheers for Mejiro
Dober
after witnessing such a
spectacular performance
from the
up-and-comer of the Mejiro family!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
She's done well to win the favor of the
crowd.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Still, she's never experienced being
under the
scrutiny of so many. How will
she react, I
wonder...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: (E-everyone's looking at me.)

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Oh, number eight, Mejiro Dober is
rounding the
last turn!

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
She stumbled and fell after coming out
of the
gate, but she hasn't given up!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: (Oh no... This feeling...)

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: You're doing your best! Just keep it up!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Just a little farther! You can do it!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: (...No. No, no, no, no!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
(Why are those stupid memories coming
back
now?! Things are completely
different from back
then!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
(I ran well today! I finished the race and
did
amazing, so why—)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
(Everyone's yelling. Their voices, their
eyes. Their
eyes are on me. They're
looking at me. Their
eyes—)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Am I going to have to run amidst all
these stares
and voices... forever?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I have to run... in all this chaos?

text_block_list.name: Young Dober
text_block_list.text: Huff... huff... gasp...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
(No, no, no, no! I promised! I promised
Bright!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I can't stop shaking... Stop it! Stop it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
When I head out to meet Mejiro Dober
after her
amazing performance, I notice
something's off.
She looks pale and she's
trembling.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...I'm fine.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Yeah. Don't worry about me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Nothing's wrong! I'll be able to run in the

Japanese Oaks just fine!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I'll run just as well at the Japanese Oaks,
so don't
worry about a thing.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I have to! I can't afford to do otherwise!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I'll be perfectly fine... everything's
fine!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Dober is as pale as a ghost... She
hardly
even looks at me as she mumbles
to herself. She
runs off before I can say
anything.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A few days after the Oka Sho, while
we're training
for the Japanese Oaks...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant, pant...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Dober is immersing herself fully in
her
training, but I can tell something's
still off...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A shadow clouds her expression, and
she's
constantly distracted, as though
she's trying to
shake off a thought she
just can't get rid of.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Hello. Apologies for interrupting your
training.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I was hoping I could speak to you for a
few
minutes about Dober.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
She's been acting strange ever since the
Oka Sho,
hasn't she?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I might know what Dober is struggling
with at the
moment.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
For that reason, I'm afraid I must impose
a
request upon you.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Would you mind if I spoke with her in
private?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
About what she's fighting against. I wish
to reveal
its true nature to her, as I don't
think she realizes
what it is.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
However, this is ultimately a problem
between
you and her. If you don't
approve of my
meddling, you are free to
decline.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I know that something happened at the
Oka Sho,
but I have no idea what I
should say to make her
feel better.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I want to do whatever I can to support
her, and
right now, the best thing to do
is ask for help.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Understood. Thank you for allowing me
to speak
with her.
choice_data_list: ドーベルと、話してやってほしい

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
In return, I promise to dispel the
vexation you
grip in your fists and honor
the sentiment which
you hold for her in
your heart.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's not until Air Groove says that that I
finally
realize my hands are curled into
tight fists.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We don't have much time before the
Japanese
Oaks. For now, all I can do is
hope that Mejiro
Dober will be back to
normal in time.
